name: 30507 · Gainesville, GA
findings: ZIP 30507 (Gainesville) has 29 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 8 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30507 (Gainesville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 30507 (Gainesville) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 30% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.
